content.rendered:
Download FTS 19 Super Mod Update Transfer Apk Data Obb for Android with latest features.

This first Touch Soccer game is so dynamic that you are going to like most of the features that comes with it.

The players have been giving new faces that makes them to look so unique, even their skills have been upgraded in this version of FTS 19 Super Mod.

The control buttons have not been left out in this super mod of FTS 19, because the buttons can now be clearly seen and are so soft to control without any lagging issues or force closing.

The pitch and stadiums now tends to look like real life football pitch making it to look so beautiful during gameplay.

The commentary system have been totally worked on and new broadcast stations have been added which will be listed below.

FTS 19 Super mod update transfer is just a classic soccer game that you just don’t want miss, you can further read about the features below.

Features Of FTS 19 Super Mod Update Transfer

  • Now loaded with complete super league 100%
  • Latest Winter transfer whereby coutinho moved to Barcelona, Alexis moves to Man United etc.
  • New sound tracks added.
  • Apk, obb have all been modified with new skin, grass, player boots, logo, players kits and more.
  • New broadcast station added such as Fox sports.
  • New game modes such as quick match, Race mod, Tournament Mod etc.
  • Skills of the players have been upgraded just like FIFA 18.
  • Better hosted tournament with all players included (Reserves, Alternate, Holders).
  • New control routers.

Download Links

FTS 19 Super Mod Update Transfer Data

Obb FTS 19 Super Mod Update Transfer

How To Install

After you download all the required files above, just follow the simple steps below to install the game.

  1. At first install FTS 19 Super mod Apk, don’t open yet.
  2. Use Zarchiver or any other zip file extractor to extract the game data into Android/data folder.
  3. For the game obb, use same Zarchiver to extract the Obb file into Android/obb folder.
  4. Now open FTS 19 Super mod from your app menu and start playing.
